maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from new connected fitness equipment sales and subscription memberships, not repair or servicing of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers paying for Peloton bikes, treads and memberships, with HSA/FSA or Affirm financing as payment routes.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from selling its own hardware, memberships and content; acquisitions such as Precor were occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer fitness subscriptions and equipment are discretionary; users can cancel or switch to other gyms or apps with little disruption.
